decks.name: LeetCode #215 - Kth Largest Element in an Array
decks.description: Find kth largest element in unsorted array

cards.question: Kth Largest Element in an Array: Given an integer array nums and an integer k, return the kth largest element in the array. Note that it is the kth largest element in the sorted order, not the kth distinct element. Can you solve it without sorting?

solutions.name: Sorting
solutions.explanation: Sort entire array and return element at index (n-k). Simple approach but sorts all elements even though only need kth largest. O(n log n) time complexity. Space O(1) or O(n) depending on sort algorithm. Not optimal but straightforward solution.

solutions.name: Min-Heap
solutions.explanation: Use min-heap of size k to maintain k largest elements. Python's heapq.nlargest efficiently does this - maintains heap of k elements, processes all n elements with O(log k) operations. Returns smallest element in heap (kth largest overall). O(n log k) time, O(k) space. More efficient than sorting when k is small.

solutions.name: Quick Select
solutions.explanation: Use partition-based selection to find kth largest without full sort. Convert to finding (n-k)th smallest for easier indexing. Partition array around pivot, recursively search correct side based on pivot position. Average O(n) time with good pivots. Worst case O(n²) with poor pivots. Space O(n) for recursion stack. Efficient average case solution.

solutions.name: Quick Select (Optimal)
solutions.explanation: Enhanced iterative quick select with median-of-three pivot selection and optimized partitioning. Finds kth largest directly without recursion. Uses three-way median pivot selection to avoid worst case. Iterative approach with O(1) space. Handles small subarrays efficiently. Average O(n) time, worst case O(n²) but less likely with better pivot. Most space-efficient quick select variant.
